name: smwmusic-lagrange-point-city-of-birthday
title: Lagrange Point - City of Birthday
description:
Yep, that's the name of the song.
The song from one of the big towns of the game.
Cause this song have a large usage of external samples, the thunder SFX sample is not compatible, and @7 were ommited as well.

There's two soundfonts included inside the port, one that was extracted from the NSF files, and Famitracker, and other from the ROM through an emulator. To choose between the two, change the "ROM_Soundfont" define to 0 to use the NSF soundfont, and vice-versa.

12/06 Update: Fixed piano sample, as it was one octave low.
